event_station_013@node_spine_2.quirk: There is lichen on their shoulder. Neither of them seems concerned.

shipLog.text: ◆ Station approach. MARV is reviewing the station's trade reputation. The reputation is 'adequate.' MARV considers this an improvement.
◆ Seeds in medium. MARV notes the crop is the only passenger aboard expected to produce something. He has adjusted his expectations of the others accordingly.
Arrived: Kepler-78b (Provisional). The leg cost −2 FUEL, −2 FOOD, −2 H2O, −1 O2, 7 DAYS. Filed.
◆ Soil sampler survey logged (1/3). The colony office will want this.
◆ A tomato has fallen off the vine. Three crew members have opinions about this. (−2 morale)
Departure Protocol. The captain chose “Check the crop one last time before departure”. Noted.
The crop is fine. +2 MORALE, 1 DAY. It will not last.
◆ Passing the window: a welcome mat.
Arrived: The Bargain Bin. The leg cost −2 FUEL, −2 FOOD, −2 H2O, +2 MORALE, −1 O2, 7 DAYS. Filed.
◆ CHIP files a reference next to the Provident's registry entry: ships built to carry whole generations are a real, seriously-studied idea.
The Other Colony Ship. The captain chose “Hail them — friendly, mostly”. Noted.
You open a channel and spend an hour trading route notes, complaints… +3 MORALE, 1 DAY. It will not last.
